## About these materials

-   All materials are written in Markdown (`.qmd`), except recorded lectures.
-   There are no slides on this website — each module explains how to generate slides from its Markdown.
-   New to the terminology? See the [Glossary](course_modules/Glossary/glossary.qmd).
